abstract: In order to elucidate the regulation of placental growth, we have characterized the expression of proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA), apoptotic DNA fragmentation and bc1-2 protein in human placenta during pregnancy. PCNA and bc1-2 protein expression were examined by immunohistochemical techniques, while the occurrence of apoptotic DNA fragmentation was assessed by in situ analysis of DNA 3'-end labeling method. Both PCNA expression and apoptotic DNA fragmentation were found in cytotrophoblasts (C-cells), being most abundant in early placenta, less abundant in midterm placenta and least abundant in term placenta. In contrast, bc1-2 protein expression was found in syncytiotrophoblasts (S-cells), being least abundant in early placenta, less abundant in midterm placenta and most abundant in term placenta. These data indicate that early placenta is characterized by the highly proliferative activity of C-cells associated with the increased occurrence of apoptosis, whereas term placenta is characterized by the abundant expression of bc1-2 protein in S-cells. Furthermore, effects of EGF on the proliferative activity and differentiated function of trophoblasts were investigated using an organ culture system. Expiants of trophoblastic tissues were cultured with or without EGF, in the presence or absence of 10(-8) M triiodo-L-thyronine (T3) in a serum-free condition. In 4-5 week placentas, EGF and EGF receptor were almost exclusively localized in C-cells, and EGF augmented the proliferative activity of C-cells without affecting the ability to secrete hCG and hPL. By contrast, in 6-12 week placentas, EGF and EGF receptor were predominantly localized in S-cells, and EGF stimulated hCG and hPL secretion without affecting the proliferative activity of C-cess. The addition of T(3) (10(-8) M) resulted in an increased secretion of immunoreactive EGF by cultured placental explants. These findings suggest that EGF acts as a local factor in regulating early placental growth and function in synergy with thyroid hormone. On the other hand, progesterone selectively inhibited pleise hCG (α, β) mRNAs expression and decreased hCG secretion in normal placental tissues, whereas choriocarcinoma did not respond to progesterone. This suggests that inhibitory regulation of hCG synthesis in choriocarcinoma is different from normal placenta. It was also found that in molar trophoblasts and choriocarcinoma cells PCNA expression was high, but both bc1-2 protein and apoptotic signal expression were low. Characterization of choriocarcinoma hCG revealed that there are striking differences in carbohydrate structures between normal hCG and choriocarcinoma hCG. Sialic acid content in choriocarcinoma hCG was extremely lower compared to that in normal hCG. The detection of the alteration in hCG sugar chains is useful for biochemical diagnosis of choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 胎盤の増殖調節を明らかにするため、妊娠中のヒト胎盤における増殖細胞核抗原（PCNA）、アポトーシスDNA断片化、bcl-2タンパク質の発現を特徴づけた。PCNAおよびbcl-2タンパク質の発現は免疫組織化学的手法で、アポトーシスDNA断片化はDNA 3'末端標識法のin situ解析により評価した。PCNA発現とアポトーシスDNA断片化は細胞性栄養膜細胞（C細胞）に認められ、早期胎盤で最も多く、中期胎盤でやや少なく、満期胎盤で最も少なかった。一方、bcl-2タンパク質発現は合胞体栄養膜細胞（S細胞）に認められ、早期胎盤で最も少なく、中期胎盤でやや多く、満期胎盤で最も多かった。これらの結果から、早期胎盤はアポトーシスの増加を伴うC細胞の高い増殖活性を特徴とし、満期胎盤はS細胞でのbcl-2タンパク質の豊富な発現を特徴とすることが示唆された。さらに器官培養系を用いて、栄養膜細胞の増殖活性と分化機能に対するEGFの影響を検討した。4〜5週の胎盤の組織片を、無血清条件下で、EGFの存在下または非存在下、10^-8 Mのトリヨードチロニン（T3）の存在下または非存在下で培養した。4〜5週の胎盤ではEGFとEGF受容体はほぼ専らC細胞に局在し、EGFはヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびhPLの分泌能に影響せずにC細胞の増殖活性を増強した。一方、6〜12週の胎盤ではEGFとEGF受容体は主にS細胞に局在し、EGFはC細胞の増殖活性に影響せずにhCGおよびhPLの分泌を刺激した。T3（10^-8 M）の添加により、培養胎盤外植片からの免疫反応性EGFの分泌が増加した。これらの知見から、EGFは甲状腺ホルモンと協調して初期胎盤の成長と機能を調節する局所因子として作用することが示唆される。一方、プロゲステロンは正常胎盤組織においてhCG（αおよびβ）mRNAの発現を選択的に抑制し、hCG分泌を減少させたが、絨毛癌はプロゲステロンに反応しなかった。このことから、絨毛癌におけるhCG合成の抑制調節は正常胎盤とは異なることが示唆される。また、胞状奇胎栄養膜細胞および絨毛癌細胞ではPCNA発現が高い一方、bcl-2タンパク質およびアポトーシスシグナルの発現は低いことも明らかになった。絨毛癌hCGの特性解析では、正常hCGと絨毛癌hCGの間に糖鎖構造の顕著な違いがあることが判明した。絨毛癌hCGのシアル酸含量は正常hCGに比べて極めて低かった。hCG糖鎖の変化の検出は、絨毛癌の生化学的診断に有用である。
